text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...The calendar's alignment is upon us.
May each of you be endowed with power.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The wondrous flame illuminates
the path ahead.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: We shall rise above even divine grace.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
How auspicious, how joyous.
Ah, what boundless fortune!

text_block_list.name: Divine Steeds
text_block_list.text: Ties from near and far converge here.

text_block_list.name: Divine Steeds
text_block_list.text:
—We, the Divine Steeds,
shall gallop forth.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: Why is it that we exist alongside mankind?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Trace the waters upstream, look closely,
and you shall behold "the beginning."
